title: 第八章 破财免灾了
novel_title: 全民原始部落，你搞军事基地？
content_zh:
秦天并没有什么犹豫，立刻就选择了确认。

    这没什么不同意的理由。

    毕竟现在这家伙的样子，一看就知道是对他有些害怕的，在这种情况下，主动寻求交易，大概率是好事。

    所以，他没什么理由拒绝。

    这种情况下，如果可以把这人发展一下，从他身上获得一些好处，总好过将他直接格杀。

    毕竟目前还没有玩家直接产生争斗的情况，他也并不清楚是否鼓励玩家之间互相厮杀，没准这样的行为是不被规则允许的，那这不是还挺吃亏？

    但相反，要是能不费什么力气，就从别人这里获得一些好处，那肯定是更好的结果。

    反正现在，一切都以自己的迅速发育为主，这才是核心，要放在首要的任务！

    【领主孔梁想要交易给你肉*200，木材*100，石材*100 是否同意？】

    看到这样的提示，秦天都忍不住挑了挑眉毛。

    他察觉到对方的意图以后就刻意没有说话，就是想看看，在自己刚才说完那些话以后，这家伙会拿出怎样的诚意。

    没想到，只是简单恐吓一下就能拿到不少东西！

    这也让秦天感到意外。

    虽然按照自己的思路来讲，就连开采物资所用的工具，自己都可以升级，升级这些工具过后，自己获取物资的速度应该会变得比之前还要更快。

    但是既然是送上门来的好处，那就不该有不要的道理。

    所以秦天没有任何的犹豫，立刻就选择接受。

    很快，他点开背包一栏的时候，就已经能看到多了不少东西，已经进入到他的仓库当中。

    扫了几眼，确认数目比起先前确实有一定程度的提升，秦天这才放下心来。

    而对面的孔梁，心中也是后悔不已。

    这些东西，在获取的时候可都是他费了不少功夫才获取到的！

    结果现在拱手就要让人，他这心里着实有些不好受。

    但同时，也是一阵后悔。

    早知道追过来以后会是这个情况，他说什么也不追那头凶兽了！

    同时，这次的事情也无疑是给了他教训，他以后是不敢再擅闯其余人的领地了，因为谁也保不准那领地后面的人，拥有怎样可怕的实力！

    万一呢？
content_en:
Qin Tian didn't hesitate and immediately chose to confirm.

    There's no reason to disagree.

    After all, the way this guy looks now, you can tell at a glance that he is a little scared of him. In this case, taking the initiative to seek a deal is most likely a good thing.

    Therefore, he had no reason to refuse.

    In this case, if you can develop this person and get some benefits from him, it is better than killing him directly.

    After all, there has been no direct fight between players, and he doesn't know whether to encourage players to fight each other. Maybe such behavior is not allowed by the rules, so isn't this a disadvantage?

    But on the contrary, if you can get some benefits from others without any effort, that will definitely be a better result.

    Anyway, now, everything is focused on your own rapid development. This is the core and must be the top priority!

    [Lord Kong Liang wants to trade you meat*200, wood*100, and stone*100. Do you agree? 】

    Seeing such a reminder, Qin Tian couldn't help but raise his eyebrows.

    After he noticed the other party's intention, he deliberately didn't speak, just to see how sincere this guy would be after what he just said.

    Unexpectedly, just a simple intimidation can get a lot of things!

    This also surprised Qin Tian.

    Although according to my own thinking, even the tools used to mine materials can be upgraded by myself. After upgrading these tools, I should be able to obtain materials faster than before.

    But since it is a benefit delivered to your door, there should be no reason not to use it.

    Therefore, Qin Tian immediately chose to accept it without any hesitation.

    Soon, when he clicked on the backpack column, he could already see a lot more things that had entered his warehouse.

    After scanning a few times and confirming that the number had indeed increased to a certain extent compared to before, Qin Tian felt relieved.

    Kong Liang, who was opposite him, was filled with regret.

    He spent a lot of effort to obtain these things!

    As a result, he now had to give it up to someone else, which made him feel really uncomfortable.

    But at the same time, there was also a pang of regret.

    If he had known that this would be the case after chasing him, he would never have chased that vicious beast!

    At the same time, this incident has undoubtedly taught him a lesson. He will not dare to trespass into other people's territory in the future, because no one can guarantee the terrifying strength of the people behind the territory!

    What if?
title_en: Chapter 8 Losing money and avoiding disaster
